name: Noah
fact: Built a huge ark and took the animals in, two by two.

name: Abraham
fact: God promised him a family as many as the stars in the sky.

name: Sarah
fact: Laughed when God said she would have a baby in her old age.

name: Joseph
fact: His father gave him a special coat, and God gave him dreams.

name: Moses
fact: Led God's people out of Egypt, through the Red Sea on dry ground.

name: Miriam
fact: Played her tambourine and sang to the Lord after the Red Sea.

name: Deborah
fact: A judge who sat under a palm tree and helped Israel.

name: Ruth
fact: Told Naomi, ‘Where you go, I will go.’

name: Hannah
fact: Prayed for a son, and God gave her Samuel.

name: David
fact: A shepherd boy who beat Goliath with a sling and a stone.

name: Solomon
fact: Asked God for wisdom and became a very wise king.

name: Elijah
fact: Went up to heaven in a whirlwind, with a chariot of fire.

name: Esther
fact: A brave queen who went to the king to save her people.

name: Daniel
fact: God shut the lions' mouths when Daniel was put in their den.

name: Jonah
fact: Was inside a great fish for three days and three nights.

name: Mary
fact: The angel Gabriel told her she would be the mother of Jesus.

name: John the Baptist
fact: Lived in the desert, ate locusts and wild honey, and baptised people.

name: Peter
fact: A fisherman who stepped out of the boat and walked on the water.

name: Matthew
fact: A tax collector who got up from his table to follow Jesus.

name: Zacchaeus
fact: A short man who climbed a tree to see Jesus.

name: Martha
fact: Welcomed Jesus into her home and was busy serving.

name: Mary Magdalene
fact: The first person to see Jesus after He rose again.

name: Paul
fact: Was shipwrecked on his travels telling people about Jesus.

name: Thomas
fact: Saw the risen Jesus and said, ‘My Lord and my God!’
